description:
Batch form of `ghostroute_check`: one verdict per subject, aligned to
input order. A subject that fails returns `{ok:false, error}` inline;
the batch never fails as a whole.

Use this tool when:
- You need routing-integrity / sovereignty verdicts for many endpoints at once.

Inputs:
- `subjects` (body, required): 1-50 IPs, domains, ASNs (AS####) or cert hashes.
- `receipt` (body, optional): when `true`, each verdict is a signed, persisted GhostRoute receipt.

Returns:
- `count`, `results[]` — each `{ok, subject, ...verdict}` (plus `receipt_id`, `signature` when receipts were requested).

Cost:
- Each subject costs one rate-limit unit (the first is the request itself).
  A batch larger than the remaining budget is refused whole with 429 and
  charges nothing beyond that first unit, so the effective maximum per call
  is min(50, remaining + 1): anonymous 10/min, free 50/day, supporter
  500/day, pro 5,000/day, enterprise unlimited.

Latency:
- Subjects run in parallel; roughly the slowest single check (300-900ms cold).

receipt.description: When `true`, issue a signed, persisted GhostRoute receipt per subject.

name: ghostroute_batch_check
